title: C_DestroyObject: evict wolfHSM key on destroy
description: free_key_priv() for the wolfHSM backend frees the local wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t struct but does not call wh_Client_KeyEvict. Keys generated via C_GenerateKeyPair (wh_Client_EccMakeCacheKey / wh_Client_RsaMakeCacheKey) therefore persist on the server until it evicts them by capacity or timeout. A well-behaved PKCS#11 implementation should evict the server-side key when C_DestroyObject is called, to avoid accumulating stale keys on resource-constrained HSM servers. Fix: call wh_Client_KeyEvict(ctx->client, key_priv->key_id) in free_key_priv() before freeing the struct, guarded so that pre-provisioned (NVM-persistent) keys are not accidentally evicted. This may require a flag in wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t to distinguish generated-here keys from pre-provisioned keys.
